scope: Development admission contrast of the exact frozen Nextflow task graph in an independently limited head workspace; not held-out scientific R2.4 or aggregate client plus remote R2.2.
storageUnit: XFS allocated project blocks including staged inputs, work/logs and materialized portable run copy. Operator supervisor evidence and pre-existing image/Nextflow caches are outside this scope.
interpretation: Independent head-workspace oracle includes portable duplication but excludes actual client preparation/export. Its counterfactual matrix diagnoses admission conservatism for this adapted scope; it does not establish a protocol end-to-end false-rejection metric. All original attempts and unknowns are retained.

report.scope: Development admission contrast of the exact frozen Nextflow task graph in an independently limited head workspace; not held-out scientific R2.4 or aggregate client plus remote R2.2.
report.unit: XFS allocated project blocks including staged inputs, work/logs and materialized portable run copy. Operator supervisor evidence and pre-existing image/Nextflow caches are outside this scope.
report.interpretation: Same-input execution supplies scoped empirical labels, not the admisor or cohort names. Actual local-client preparation/export is outside this oracle, so scoped false rejections do not establish estimator error on an identical end-to-end storage scope.
